name: Embryonic limb and digit morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic morphogenesis of the limbs or digits, unlike the craniofacial, neural-plate and somite patterning confusables.

name: Aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification and glycation repair
rationale: Members cover aldehyde and methylglyoxal clearance, repair of glycated protein and DNA, and molybdenum-cofactor oxidases (aldehyde/sulfite oxidation), distinguishing it from the ROS, vitamin B6 and glutathione confusables.

name: Cortical neuron migration and layer formation
rationale: Members are tangential and radial-glia-guided neuron migration and lamination/regionalization of cortex and related forebrain structures, whereas confusables emphasize commissures, reelin signalling, neuron-type commitment and retina/thalamus.

name: BAF chromatin remodeling complexes and histone acetylation
rationale: Members center on assembly of the BAF remodeling complex variants with histone/protein acetylation and nucleosome organization, while confusables add CHD6-9, NuRD and histone methylation machinery.

name: Motile cilia and sperm flagellum assembly and beating
rationale: All members concern axonemal assembly and beating of motile cilia (mucociliary clearance, CSF flow) and sperm flagella, unlike the left-right nodal cilia, primary-cilium trafficking and tubulin-modification confusables.

name: Hair cell mechanosensation in hearing and vestibular balance
rationale: Members are mechanosensory function of cochlear and vestibular hair cells (stereocilia, otoliths, gravity, vestibular reflex), whereas confusables cover inner ear morphogenesis, cell fate and microvillus assembly.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
rationale: Members are meiotic double-strand break formation, strand invasion, synaptonemal complex and prophase checkpoints, unlike confusables on meiotic segregation, mitotic spindle, cohesion and germline epigenetics.

name: UDP-N-acetylglucosamine and sialic acid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid and their defects (GFPT1, GNE, ALG14), distinguishing it from GlcNAc catabolism, dolichol and GDP-mannose confusables.

name: Skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and homeostasis
rationale: Members share skeletal muscle fiber differentiation and maintenance, whereas confusables cover cardiac adaptation, sarcomere contraction and myoblast fusion/proliferation.

qualifier: negative regulation downstream of TLR and IL-1
name: Suppression of TLR-induced proinflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members are negative regulation of TLR2/4, LPS and IL-1 signalling and of IL-1, IL-6, IL-12 and TNF production, unlike confusables on NF-kB/TNF signalling, IL-10, positive regulation and inflammasomes.

qualifier: complexes I, III and ATP synthase
name: Mitochondrial complex I, III and ATP synthase assembly
rationale: Members are assembly of complex I, complex III and ATP synthase with inner-membrane protein insertion, whereas confusables add complex IV, electron transport, Fe-S clusters and protein import.

name: Glycerol and alditol metabolism with fructose synthesis
rationale: Members are glycerol, glycerol-3-phosphate and alditol metabolism plus fructose biosynthesis, distinguishing it from pentose phosphate, fructose catabolism and acylglycerol synthesis confusables.

core: Regulation of TLR signaling and inflammatory cytokines
qualifier: MyD88-, TLR3/4- and CD40-linked positive and negative control
name: Positive and negative tuning of TLR-driven cytokine production
rationale: Members regulate TLR3/4, MyD88, CD40 and IL-1 signalling and IL-6, IL-8 and TNF output in both directions, unlike confusables centred on inflammasomes, LPS detection or TRIF/TAK1 signal transduction.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell regulation and erythrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover HSC homeostasis, proliferation and differentiation and primitive/definitive erythrocyte differentiation, whereas confusables add bone marrow cell number, terminal enucleation or general stem cell maintenance.

name: Thyroid hormone production and hydrogen peroxide homeostasis
rationale: Members are thyroid hormone generation, transport and activity together with H2O2 synthesis and catabolism that supplies thyroid peroxidase, unlike sulfonation, ascorbate and selenium/thyroid-hormone-response confusables.

name: Epidermal cornification and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members are cornified envelope assembly, keratinocyte differentiation and skin barrier/epidermal morphogenesis, whereas confusables add keratinocyte proliferation control, hair follicle, cell adhesion and epidermal lipoxygenase pathways.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT
name: Insulin/IGF1R and ALK-family receptor signaling via PI3K-AKT
rationale: Members are tyrosine autophosphorylation, IRS/SHC/SOS adaptor events and AKT activation downstream of IGF1R/insulin receptor and ALK/LTK, distinguishing it from FGFR, ERBB/MET, RAS-MAPK and oncogenic fusion confusables.

name: Intestinal lipid absorption and triglyceride-rich lipoprotein assembly
rationale: Members cover dietary lipid, sterol and vitamin E absorption and chylomicron/VLDL assembly, whereas confusables concern lipoprotein remodeling and clearance, cholesterol homeostasis and bile acids.

name: TKI resistance of KIT, FLT3 and PDGFR mutants
rationale: Members are drug-resistant and signalling mutants of the type III receptor kinases KIT, FLT3 and PDGFR, unlike confusables featuring ALK resistance, FGFR/PDGFR fusions and FLT3 CBL regulation.

name: Camera-type eye morphogenesis and anterior segment development
rationale: Members are eye, lens, iris, cornea, eyelid and hyaloid vascular development and remodeling, whereas confusables concern photoreceptor and retinal neuron differentiation, optic nerve and lacrimal gland.

qualifier: ATF6, XBP1, ATF4 and CREB3 chaperone induction
name: Unfolded protein response transcription factors inducing chaperone genes
rationale: Members are ER-stress transcription factors (ATF6, XBP1, ATF4, CREB3) activating chaperone genes, unlike confusables on translational stress control, IRE1/PERK regulation, apoptosis and SREBP.

name: Threonine and L-amino acid catabolism
rationale: Members are threonine catabolism and general L-amino acid metabolism/catabolism, distinguishing it from glycine conjugation, glycine/glyoxylate and proline confusables.

name: Vitamin D metabolism and sodium-phosphate cotransport
rationale: Members are vitamin D activation/inactivation, FGF23-Klotho and PTH responses and SLC34 Na+/Pi cotransporters, whereas confusables cover steroid hormones, tooth and ectopic mineralization.

name: Fanconi anemia cross-link repair and protein monoubiquitination
rationale: Most members concern the Fanconi anemia pathway with its FANCD2/FANCI monoubiquitination and deubiquitination plus genome-maintenance gene modules, distinguishing it from BRCA/DSB response, checkpoint and polyubiquitin-chain confusables (one module on RB1/BCL2L1 fits only loosely).

name: Intestinal epithelial barrier development and maintenance
rationale: All members concern development and structural maintenance of the intestinal epithelial sheet, whereas confusables cover antimicrobial defense and HNF4-driven absorptive enterocyte programs.
